jobs.description:
It’s an exciting time to join Tactile. We're a diverse team of storytellers, puzzle enthusiasts, and casual mobile game creators. Our story began in 2008 in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, and since then, we have experienced continuous growth, establishing ourselves as one of the largest gaming companies in Denmark. In more recent years, we have been scaling fast, in large part thanks to the success of a little game called Lily’s Garden. Now we’re on a mission to solidify our position as one of the leaders in creating out-of-the-ordinary casual puzzle games.

With more than 350 talented individuals, we are a mix of over 50 nationalities and 43% women. We truly appreciate the richness of different experiences and perspectives that Tactilers bring to the game. This is why we foster a lean organisational culture, in which each individual is encouraged to take responsibility, be open, and grow in their own way. We pride ourselves on cultivating a studio environment that avoids crunch, fosters your skills regardless of your discipline, and provides a space for you to be creative alongside other passionate and invested storytellers.

**🚀 Your Role & Impact

**We're currently growing our Core team and are on the lookout for another Product Designer to join our team of talented engineers.

The Core team builds the internal tools behind Tactile own LiveOps, Marketing and Data operations, the backbone of our studio. We're looking for a second Product Designer to join Joy and our engineers in designing business-critical tools that every team at Tactile depends on.

**This role is based in our Copenhagen office.

****How We Design

**

• Our tools are data-heavy: dashboards, large tables, complex filters, multi-step workflows. Static mockups can't show how they behave with real data, so we prototype first, in code. We use Claude Code and agentic workflows to build working prototypes, and those prototypes are what we hand off to developers. Figma is still where we sketch and brainstorm

• AI amplifies our design. It doesn't do design for us. It lets us take on complex workflows that used to get skipped because they took too much effort

• Quality is not up for debate. We know what good looks like, and we don't ship slop

• Our product design philosophies are inspired by Vercel, Linear and GitHub

This is roughly how we work today. It isn't strict, and we're open to what you bring. Here's a talk that captures our thinking.

Okay, let’s get a little bit more specific. Here’s what you’ll be doing on the day-to-day:

• Research, design and prototype interfaces for our internal tools, then hand working prototypes off to developers

• Work with your team who use our tools to simplify their workflows

• Use AI to explore, iterate and prototype efficiently, while you stay responsible for every design decision and not outsource creative thinking.

• Evolve and contribute to our design system and processes

• We don't have a big UX team, and that's on purpose. You'll work every day with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend engineers, Artists, Game Programmers. We believe good products come from working across disciplines, so we care about the end product, not design operations

**What We’re Looking For

**

• Hands-on experience with technical B2B products: dashboards, tables, filters, dense interfaces

• You care more about the end product than about design process, and you thrive working across disciplines

• Comfortable contributing directly to projects via PRs to improve designs or UX without waiting for programmers to implement them

• Experience in designing with Claude Code or similar agentic tools

• Real openness to agentic workflows, without an "AI produces slop" mindset

• Comfort prototyping in code, or a strong drive to learn

• A sharp eye for high design craft, quality, and candour when something isn't good enough

**You'll Make Us Extra Excited If You Also Have

**

• Experience in using Figma/Figma Make or similar design tools

• Programmer background, comfortable diving into fronted code if necessary

• Know-how of shadcn, Untitled UI or similar SaaS UI libraries

**What’s in it for you?

**🌆 Beautiful office space with probably the best view in Copenhagen

🩺 Pension and private health insurance

💻 A chance to work with the latest tools and technology

📚 Opportunities for individual growth with development talks as well as workshops, books and courses

🌮 Daily, healthy organic breakfast and lunch prepared by our professional chefs in-house

🥳 Social activities, including game nights, book club, Friday bar and more

🔍 Free Danish lessons with our in-house Danish teacher

**Our interview process

**Submit your application via the fill-in form at the top of this page. This is the easiest and fastest way to get in touch with our recruiters. We foster an inclusive culture and accessible workplace and want to make sure we provide everyone with the same opportunities for success. This is why we encourage you to apply regardless of your gender, sexuality, age, nationality, neurodiversity or disability. We review applications based on competencies and experience, so please do tell us about your favorite projects and technologies.

After we review your application, you can expect to go through the following conversations:

☕ Introductory coffee chat, primarily to ensure that we’re aligned on the scope of the role and that all of your questions are answered.

🧪 In person technical interview (mix of design whiteboarding and designing with AI) with Joy, your future product design colleague, and Gab, Core Team Lead.

💜 The final conversation will be with your future team, to discuss if you’re aligned on values and ways of working.

We are thorough in our hiring process, as it's essential to us that we select new Tactilers carefully - just as it is vital to ensure that we are the right place for you.

We want to ensure you have a great candidate experience whilst in our recruitment process. We will do everything within reason to ensure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please let us know.

We look forward to receiving your application! 👋

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant, S&OP/IBP - Global Supply Chain Planning & Analytics
jobs.description:
_Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to gain hands-on experience in global supply chain planning? Do you enjoy working with data, generating insights, and supporting business decision-making?

_Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain. In this role, you will contribute to the monthly planning cycle and metal hedging process through data consolidation, analysis, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.

You will take ownership of selected recurring deliverables and support the improvement of planning tools, inventory management, data quality, and processes across Global Supply Chain.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), supply chain analytics, inventory planning, and process improvement in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain valuable insight into how data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration drive operational and commercial decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Consolidate data and prepare reports, analyses, and meeting materials for the monthly S&OP/IBP cycle.

• Take ownership of selected recurring reports and data-consolidation activities.

• Develop and maintain planning tools, dashboards, KPIs, and inventory projections with guidance from the team.

• Support the metal hedging process by consolidating forecasts, conducting analyses, preparing decision materials, and coordinating stakeholder input.

• Analyze inventory, production, and supply chain performance and translate data into clear business insights.

• Coordinate meeting agendas, materials, stakeholder input, action tracking, and follow-up.

• Contribute to improvements in planning processes, reporting, automation, and data quality.

• Support ad hoc analyses and tasks as required.

**Your Team

**You will join the S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain and report to the S&OP/IBP Manager. The team collaborates closely with stakeholders across Crafting & Supply, Global Treasury, and other areas within Global Supply Chain to support planning, decision-making, and business performance.

As part of the team, you will gain first-hand experience with how integrated planning processes connect demand, supply, inventory, and financial considerations across a global organization.

**Qualifications

**

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

• Ideally have at least one year remaining of your studies.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, Power Query, and working with large datasets.

• Comfortable working with data and translating it into meaningful insights.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with BI, ERP, MRP, WMS, reporting, or planning tools is considered an advantage.

• Previous full-time work experience is not required. Relevant experience gained through student employment, internships, university projects, or similar activities is considered an advantage.

• An interest in automation, digitalization, and AI-enabled planning processes is considered a plus.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical and curious, with a strong interest in supply chain planning, S&OP, and Integrated Business Planning.

• Structured and detail-oriented in your approach to tasks and problem-solving.

• Proactive and eager to learn, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for assigned deliverables.

• A clear and confident communicator.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Able to balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

**You Will Get

**

• Hands-on experience with S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, and global supply chain processes.

• Opportunities to work with data consolidation, reporting, analysis, and inventory planning.

• Insight into the metal hedging process and the coordination of forecasts and stakeholder input.

• Exposure to cross-functional collaboration across Global Supply Chain, Crafting & Supply, and Global Treasury.

• Opportunities to develop your Excel, analytical, and business communication skills.

• Experience taking ownership of recurring reports and deliverables.

• The opportunity to contribute to improvements in planning processes, automation, reporting, and data quality.

**Additional Information

**

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Are you curious about how products go from idea to market in a global technology company? As a Student Worker in Product Management, you will help shape solutions for the international air-conditioning and refrigeration industry while gaining hands-on experience in a business-critical function.

In this role, you will support product development, market analysis, product launches, and supplier collaboration. Your work will help transform customer and market insights into actions that create value for customers around the world.

You will join Danfoss Climate Solutions and work closely with experienced colleagues across functions and geographies. This is an opportunity to develop both your commercial and technical understanding while building a strong professional network in an international environment.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Support product development and launch activities by coordinating inputs, documentation, and follow-up actions to help projects move forward successfully.

• Research market trends, customer needs, and competitor developments to identify insights and business opportunities.

• Collaborate with colleagues and suppliers to align activities and ensure smooth execution across functions.

• Prepare presentations, business analyses, and product information that support decision-making and communication.

• Contribute to portfolio and product-management activities by organizing information and helping drive key initiatives.

**What We're Looking For

**

• You are currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor's or master's program and can combine your studies with approximately 12-15 working hours per week.

• You have a strong interest in product management, technology, business development, and international markets.

• You have an analytical and structured approach and enjoy working with data, information, and business insights.

• You communicate clearly in English and can collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.

• You take initiative, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll gain practical experience in an international product management environment where your contributions have real impact.

You will have the opportunity to learn about product development, product launches, portfolio management, supplier collaboration, and business development while working alongside experienced professionals. We believe in learning through responsibility, and you will gradually take ownership of your own tasks and projects.

This position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark, with flexible working arrangements that support your studies and provide additional flexibility during examination periods.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited about combining business, technology, and market insights in a global organization, we'd love to hear from you. Even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply and share how your skills and perspective can contribute to the team.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description

You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile

We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.

• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets.

• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.

• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).

• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project

Who we are

The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students).

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network.  The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer

• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information

Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579).

Deadline

All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Forensics Solutions Activation Leader Associate Director
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Location: European hubs (flexible)

Level: Associate Director

Employment type: Permanent, full time

**Role Summary

**We are seeking a commercially minded, market-facing leader to drive the growth and adoption of our portfolio of digitally enabled and AI-enhanced forensic solutions across Europe, with extension into APAC. Our Integrity & Compliance solution is a flagship offering within this portfolio and will feature prominently — but the role spans the wider set of technology-led forensic solutions we need to commercialise.

The central purpose of the role is market activation: helping country and regional Forensics teams move from traditional, manual delivery to modern, technology-led ways of serving clients — and, in doing so, unlocking new revenue. The successful candidate will partner with local leaders to build go-to-market approaches, shape and win opportunities, and accelerate the adoption of new solutions in their markets.

This is a commercial and go-to-market role first. The successful candidate does not need deep, hands-on technical expertise, but must be fluent enough in forensic technology and AI to speak about it credibly, translate capability into client value, and help territories both commercialise and deliver these solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Strategic Market Development

**

• Drive the execution of the European (and, by extension, APAC) growth strategy for our digitally enabled forensic solutions, aligned to global priorities and regional targets.

• Identify market opportunities, emerging regulatory trends and client needs to expand the solution portfolio across countries.

• Partner with Regional and Country Forensics leaders to build market plans, go-to-market approaches and priority pursuits.

• Develop practical playbooks, propositions, case studies and market materials that help countries accelerate revenue and client penetration.

• Track market performance and pipeline to focus effort where growth potential is greatest.

**Driving Adoption & Commercial Enablement

**

• Lead the shift from manual, traditional delivery to technology-led delivery — acting as the catalyst for behaviour change across local teams.

• Equip country leaders and teams to confidently position, sell and scale technology-enabled forensic solutions.

• Act as a trusted commercial advisor to country leaders establishing or expanding these offerings.

• Facilitate knowledge sharing and leading practices across Europe and APAC to build commercial momentum and consistency.

• Help local leaders understand — at the right level — how technology, analytics and AI translate into client value and competitive advantage.

**Client Engagement & Commercial Leadership

**

• Support strategic pursuits and priority opportunities across the forensic solution portfolio, including Integrity & Compliance, investigations, monitoring, forensic data analytics, eDiscovery, third-party and regulatory risk, and AI-enabled solutions.

• Help countries shape complex proposals and solution approaches for priority opportunities.

• Identify cross-border opportunities and bring global capability to bear to win and deliver client work.

• Drive pipeline development and revenue growth across priority markets.

**Market Presence & Thought Leadership

**

• Represent the firm at client forums, industry events and internal leadership meetings.

• Champion the firm's perspective on technology-enabled, AI-enhanced forensic solutions.

• Develop market insights and commercial materials that support business development and portfolio growth.

• Deliver compelling presentations and demos for country leaders, practitioners and clients.

**Stakeholder Management

**

• Build strong relationships with Regional and Country Forensics leaders to advance growth objectives.

• Influence senior stakeholders across geographies to back adoption and growth initiatives.

• Foster cross-region collaboration to share resources, opportunities and leading practices.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Demonstrated success in commercialising services and driving revenue growth within a professional services environment — ideally new or technology-enabled offerings.

• Proven ability to drive change and adoption across distributed, matrixed teams.

• Strong client network and market-facing relationships that can be leveraged.

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and executive-level communication skills.

• Sufficient fluency in forensic technology and AI to speak credibly and connect capability to client value — deep hands-on technical expertise is not required.

• 10–15 years' experience within Forensics, Compliance, Regulatory Risk, Financial Crime, Investigations or related Forensic & Integrity services.

**Preferred

**

• Experience across European and APAC markets.

• Knowledge of Integrity & Compliance disciplines (ABC, third-party risk, monitoring, investigations, ethics programmes).

• Awareness of advanced analytics and AI applications relevant to forensics and regulatory risk.

• Multilingual capabilities (English plus another major European language).

**Success Metrics

**

• Revenue growth and pipeline expansion across the forensic solution portfolio in Europe and APAC.

• Measurable shift from manual/traditional to technology-led delivery in priority markets measured through adoption of technology.

• Increased capability and participation of country teams in selling and delivering technology-enabled solutions.

• Growth in cross-border and multi-country engagements.

• Market-facing assets and thought leadership that support commercial growth.

**Working Model

**

• Hybrid across European hubs; travel 30–50% for client meetings, country activation and leadership forums.

Reports to [confirm exact global reporting line]; close collaboration with Global, Regional and Country Forensics leadership.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management 📈

You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients.

Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work.

Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves.

• 
You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs.

• 
You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests.

• 
You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input.

• 
You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy.

• 
You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend.

You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients.

• 
Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows.

• 
A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service.

• 
An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• 
Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.

Want to shape how millions of holidaymakers discover their next getaway? At Awaze, you'll take the lead on one of the industry's largest OTA network, building strong commercial partnerships, unlocking new growth opportunities and helping us reach even more guests across Europe.

**Your mission

**As our new Head of 3rd Party Partnerships, your mission is to maximise the performance of Awaze's third-party distribution channels, from OTAs and travel agency chains to strategic digital partners.

You'll take ownership of an established partner network, with the freedom to shape its future, optimise channel performance and negotiate agreements that drive commercial growth. As a key representative of Awaze in the industry, you'll turn market insights into opportunities, working closely with Commercial, Product, Marketing and leadership teams to deliver measurable results.

**

• Identify, negotiate and secure high-value commercial agreements with new and existing partners, managing relationships from onboarding to long-term development.

• Analyse channel performance, KPIs and market trends to uncover growth opportunities and guide commercial decisions.

Do you have experience configuring, testing and commissioning control systems for high-voltage substations? Would you like to apply your expertise to projects supporting Denmark’s electricity transmission grid? Join COWI as a Substation Control and Automation Specialist.

Develop and commission substation control systems

We are looking for an experienced specialist to work on control and automation systems for Energinet’s 132–400 kV substations. Projects range from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites.

You will design, configure, test and commission substation control systems, including remote terminal units (RTUs), bay control units (BCUs) and human–machine interfaces (HMIs). Working closely with other specialists, you will ensure that these systems operate correctly and integrate with the substation’s primary equipment, protection systems and communication infrastructure.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design and configure substation control and monitoring functions in accordance with functional requirements and customer specifications.

• Configure, test and commission RTUs, bay control units and HMIs.

• Configure and verify communication interfaces between control devices, protection equipment and remote control systems.

• Plan and perform functional and integration testing to verify control functions, signal exchange and correct operation of system interfaces.

• Troubleshoot configuration, communication and interface issues in collaboration with other technical specialists.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, test procedures and test records.

• Coordinate technical interfaces with colleagues responsible for protection, communication systems, electrical design and primary equipment

• Undertake the designated on-site role of “holdleder” when required and subject to the relevant qualifications and authorisation.

Your expertise

You take a systematic approach to configuration, testing and troubleshooting. You work independently, pay close attention to technical detail and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers. You understand how individual devices and interfaces contribute to the operation of the complete substation control system.

You will also bring:

• A relevant qualification in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical background, combined with at least five years of relevant experience with control systems for high-voltage substations.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and testing substation control equipment from multiple manufacturers.

• Practical experience with IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 61850 communication protocols and standards.

• A sound understanding of the interfaces between substation control systems, protection equipment and high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience with functional testing, system integration and commissioning of substation control systems.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and meet the qualification and authorisation requirements for acting as “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.
